name: Penance Brand Ignite Elementalist
summary: Penance Brand attaches to a pack, charges up and then detonates for a large ignite. The Elementalist Shaper of Flames node makes every hit able to ignite, so the build is a fire-and-forget brand that keeps burning while you place the next one, and it needs no unique.

pros.text: The brand keeps applying damage while you move and dodge.
Ignite proliferation clears the pack from one detonation.
No required unique; fire damage and gem levels carry the build.
Brands can be pre-placed before a boss becomes targetable.
The same fire sceptre serves Righteous Fire or any fire spell later.
The damage-over-time playstyle is forgiving on reaction time.

cons.text: The brand has to charge before the big detonation lands.
Ignite damage needs time to tick, so burst phases favour other builds.
Brand attachment is a second thing to manage in a busy pack.
Fire-resistant bosses slow the fight noticeably.
The build wants a six-link for its best damage.
Elemental reflect maps are a hard no.

summary.text: Penance Brand Ignite measures 29.2k at red maps and 38.4k at pinnacle. One detonation ignites the pack, and Shaper of Flames makes every hit able to start it; no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Rolling Magma and Flame Wall, then switch to Penance Brand as soon as it unlocks. The second checkpoint measures 1097 life and 248 damage.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 29.2k damage, 30060 effective life and 9752 physical max hit. Place the brand on the pack, let the detonation ignite it, and move to the next group.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 38.4k damage with 35994 effective life and 9914 physical max hit. Pre-place the brand before the boss is targetable, then refresh it after every immunity phase.
